info.title: The Selling Partner API for Action Plans
info.description: The Action Plans API allows you to create, configure, and execute action plans from pre-defined templates or custom-built workflows.

get.description: Returns an action plan by ID. Use `includedData=steps` to include the plan's steps with their resolved input and output values.

parameters.name: actionPlanId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the action plan (UUID).

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: The locale for localized content, as an ISO 639 language code and ISO 3166 country code separated by a hyphen. Defaults to `en-US`.

parameters.name: includedData
parameters.description: Additional data to include in the response. Include `steps` to include the plan's steps with their resolved input and output values.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of the seller's action plans, sorted newest first by `createdDate`. Multiple filters are combined with a logical AND. Multiple values in a single filter are combined with a logical OR.

parameters.name: planTemplateIds
parameters.description: Filters by plan template IDs. Multiple values allowed.

parameters.name: actionItemIds
parameters.description: Filters by associated action item IDs. Multiple values allowed.

parameters.name: createdAfter
parameters.description: Plans created at or after this timestamp. Timestamp is in ISO 8601 format.

parameters.name: createdBefore
parameters.description: Plans created at or before this timestamp. Timestamp is in ISO 8601 format.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Maximum number of results per page.

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description:
A token to retrieve a specific page of results. Pass the `nextToken` value from a previous response.

**Note:** The `previousToken` value is not yet supported.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: The locale for localized content, as an ISO 639 language code and ISO 3166 country code separated by a hyphen. Defaults to `en-US`.

parameters.name: includedData
parameters.description: Additional data to return in the response. Specify `steps` to return each plan's steps with their resolved input and output values.

post.description: Creates an action plan from a template. Use `mode=PREVIEW` to return the plan without creating or executing it. Omit `mode` to create the plan and submit it for execution.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: The mode of operation. Set `PREVIEW` to return the plan without creating or executing it. Omit `mode` to create the plan and submit it for execution.
